name: phone_action
description: Perform one action on the user's phone when this turn runs inside the a serve Android app: set an alarm, start a note in the phone's notes app (through the system share sheet), or read the phone's current coarse location. Use this for direct requests such as 'set an alarm for 6 tomorrow' or 'what is the weather here' when the phone's location is needed. Only available in the Android client; other clients return an error. Setting an alarm is silent; a note opens the share sheet and still needs the user to pick an app; location asks for the Android permission on first use.

action.description: alarm sets a clock alarm; note opens the phone's share sheet with text; location returns one coarse position.

hour.description: Alarm hour in 24-hour local time (required for alarm).

label.description: Optional alarm label shown by the clock app.
